# has start instant

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasStartInstant`](gmeow-hasStartInstant.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasStartInstant>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The start instant of a time interval.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md) -> [`gmeow:Instant`](../classes/gmeow-Instant.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasStartInstant`](gmeow-hasStartInstant.md) from [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md) to [`gmeow:Instant`](../classes/gmeow-Instant.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to bound an interval's start with a full [`gmeow:Instant`](../classes/gmeow-Instant.md) when that endpoint itself needs a frame, granularity, determinacy, or EDTF approximation — the reified counterpart of [`gmeow:startedAtTime`](gmeow-startedAtTime.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid when a bare crisp dateTime suffices (use [`gmeow:startedAtTime`](gmeow-startedAtTime.md) inline) and avoid asserting two start instants (functional — at most one).

### How to use

- Point the interval at a single [`gmeow:Instant`](../classes/gmeow-Instant.md) carrying its own gmeow:instantValue/gmeow:edtfValue and frame; pair with [`gmeow:hasEndInstant`](gmeow-hasEndInstant.md), or omit it for an open interval.

### Examples

- ex:tenureInterval [`gmeow:hasStartInstant`](gmeow-hasStartInstant.md) ex:hireInstant.
